independent_ledger_audit.scope: Only the complete original graph-only E047 1030-step/16-request arrival history, replayed with actual batched GDN+graph. No future candidate HTTP capture, arbitrary arrivals or performance grant.
independent_ledger_audit.evidence_limit: Full per-array finite/bit comparison receipts from the pinned device producer; successful tensor payloads were not saved. No offline GPU arithmetic/tensor-byte reread.

composition.trace_counter_scope: Per-layer Python candidate/fallback branches, including graph tracing; not GPU dispatches, completed kernels, or per-token device calls.

captured.call_binding: CPU case-step/direct label plus independently inferred within-step order; no explicit token-key receipt

replay.call_binding: CPU case-step/direct label plus independently inferred within-step order; no explicit token-key receipt

routes.call_binding: Validated semantic call order per step; consumed ahead is not rerun. No explicit token key in sidecar.

limitations: Sampled observations do not bound inter-sample allocation peaks or establish physical fit.
Known/native process inventories and repeated start-time assertions have source-bound saved scope; their full raw ps history is unavailable.
Final, lease and health are recorded facts, not new live checks. Numerical raw-byte audit is separate.

scope: Only the exact original E047 1030-step/16-request recording. No candidate HTTP/performance claim. Full successful tensor payloads were not retained.
